title: Hearty Mexican Sweet Red Pepper Stew
description: A one-pot Mexican dish featuring sweet red peppers and earthy flavors, served with toast for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: sweet red peppers
ingredients.notes: any color bell pepper can be used

instructions: Heat a large cazuela over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin and chili powder to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sweet red peppers to the pot and cook until they start to soften.
Add the tomato paste and beef broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Slice the whole wheat bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
Serve the stew hot, topped with toasted bread and any desired toppings.
